text:
mei: Huge thanks to @devon (eng-platform), @sanjay (ops), and @claire (design) for staying late and squashing the payment page bug before the demo. I owe you all donuts + terrible coffee. :doughnut: :coffee:
devon: team effort — sanjay found the race condition in the payment retry handler, claire redesigned the tiny modal so it didn’t block the flow, and mei kept calm and handled the staging chaos. :raised_hands:
sanjay: the bug was a 0.2s timing window. added a tighter mutex and extra metrics. pushing a small patch now. sorry for the noise at midnight. :sweat_smile: :wrench:
claire: re: modal — visual fix plus `aria-live` announcement so screen readers see the status immediately. we should add this to the accessibility checklist. :sparkles: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploy: patch/payment-retry @production completed by sanjay at 00:42 — all health checks passed. :robot_face:
jo: that was badass. i will accept a donut on behalf of the rest of the product team who cheered in Slack. :tada: :doughnut:
carl: shoutout to @jo for coordinating a midnight run to the 24/7 bakery. donuts have landed in the kitchen (label: "late-night hero snacks"). :truck: :doughnut:
mei: tiny logistics note — if you take a donut, leave a sticky note with your name so we can track survivor counts. also drop an emoji reaction so we know who swung by. :memo: :eyes:
devon: leaving 👀 — also created a quick postmortem doc in #eng-postmortems. tl;dr: race + missing metric = midnight sprint. will add better test coverage. :page_facing_up:
sanjay: extra kudos to infra for keeping staging stable during the hotfix. sending virtual high-fives. :handshake:
claire: and an extra thanks to the UX folks who mocked the modal in 15 minutes. design sprint level: unlocked. :art: :star2:
mei: this is exactly the kind of cross-team hustle i love seeing. please add any micro-kudos below so we can share with leadership and the all-hands tonight. :heart:
ops-bot: reminder: please file any follow-ups as issues and tag the release label `postmortem-needed`.
